coverageNotes: Does not test pagination algorithm, React hook code or schema authoring.

questions.question: Which expression belongs in returns?

options.rationale: Incorrect: native pagination returns an object containing page and metadata, not a document array directly.
Correct: paginationResultValidator wraps a single full-document validator in the native page-and-metadata shape.
Incorrect: postFields omits _id and _creationTime. Convex object validators reject those undeclared fields on returned documents.
Incorrect: the helper already makes page an array. Passing an array validator requires each page element to be another array.
